title: AgentRoleCard
description: Versioned Cell contract (Issue #298 / Probe Cell Fabric). Declares a Cell's mission/scope/model alias/tool policy/acceptance template/rubric ref. This is NOT the API Role Card (Issue #58, a display model for an API's role in the system) -- the two are never mixed into one schema. provider/model real names are never embedded here: only model_alias, resolved server-side via CELL_MODEL_ALIAS_<UPPER_ALIAS> so a model-name change never requires a card revision. role_key rows are append-only per version; only status may change on an existing version row.

role_key.description: Stable identity for this role across versions (e.g. worker-summarizer, orchestrator-checkout-ux).

version.description: Semver string. role_key + version is append-only: a new revision is a new row, never an overwrite.

model_alias.description: Never a literal provider/model name (e.g. worker-default, auditor-default). Resolved to provider:model via env CELL_MODEL_ALIAS_<UPPER_ALIAS>, falling back to LLMConfig.intelligence_from_env().

acceptance_template.description: Reusable acceptance criterion strings a delegated task's acceptance list is expected to draw from.

rubric_ref.description: Reference to an externally-owned rubric (e.g. Evaluation Criteria); rubric ownership/authoring is out of scope here.

changelog.description: Required human-authored summary of what changed in this version.

schema_version.description: Contract schema version; a mismatched value is rejected fail-closed by the server contract layer.
